description: This file defines the 'Screencast' class responsible for managing screencast and video recording functionalities within a browser automation context, including frame throttling, event handling, and video recording control.

classes.name: Screencast
classes.description: Manages screencast and video recording, including frame throttling and event handling.

classes.name: FrameThrottler
classes.description: Handles throttling of screencast frames to control frame rate and resource usage.

methods.name: startForTracing
methods.description: Starts screencast for tracing purposes with throttling enabled.

methods.name: stopForTracing
methods.description: Stops screencast tracing and disables throttling.

methods.name: throttleFrameAck
methods.description: Acknowledges a frame with throttling logic.

methods.name: temporarilyDisableThrottling
methods.description: Recharges the throttler, allowing all frames to pass.

methods.name: launchAutomaticVideoRecorder
methods.description: Automatically launches video recorder if recording is enabled in browser context options.

methods.name: _launchVideoRecorder
methods.description: Internal method to initialize video recording with specified directory and size.

methods.name: startVideoRecording
methods.description: Starts video recording with specified options.

methods.name: startExplicitVideoRecording
methods.description: Starts explicit video recording with optional size parameter.

methods.name: startScreencast
methods.description: Begins screencast with specified listener and options.

methods.name: stopScreencast
methods.description: Stops screencast for a given listener.

methods.name: onScreencastFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming screencast frames and notifies listeners.
